NativeCommandFailure.description: Domain route failures only. rejected describes this request, not all earlier attempts under the key. Input/body parsing and authority checks can run before receipt lookup; unknown requires retaining the original full intent and idempotency key. A revision/timeline rejection after an absent receipt is distinct from an existing-key input conflict. Framework-level malformed HTTP/JSON errors are outside this envelope.

NativeCommandText.description: Nonblank text without U+0000 through U+001F; the parser trims surrounding whitespace. No field-specific length cap is imposed; the host's existing 64-KiB request body limit applies.

NativeCommandUtcMoment.description: Real calendar date/time with seconds and an explicit Z or numeric offset; up to three fractional digits. Valid input is normalized to UTC ISO milliseconds. Local time without an offset and rolled-over calendar dates are rejected.

date.description: Valid local observing-night calendar label, not a UTC instant.

latestReturnLocal.description: HH:mm local intent or explicitly null; no computed return time is inferred.

collaborative.description: Collaboration is not integrated; true is rejected rather than silently downgraded.

ItineraryDraftStage.description: Explicit user-entered stage only. IDs must be unique within the submitted array. Each start must precede its end and chronological intervals must not overlap. Computed twilight, moonless and target-window stages, and stopId binding, are not accepted by this draft command.

ItineraryDraftPatch.description: At least one field is required. inputs replaces the full input object. Changing date while existing stages are nonempty requires an explicit stages array, including an explicit empty array to clear them; it does not shift old stages automatically.

timezone.description: Timezone accepted by the server's Intl.DateTimeFormat; retained as trimmed user input.

stops.description: Current create/patch commands retain an empty list; no destination/stop-binding command is integrated.

ItineraryDraftResult.description: The receipt and itinerary describe the original committed effect. replayed true does not promise that revision is still current.

location.description: Explicit place coordinates or explicit user grid identity; grid content and selected spot identity are not provider-qualified by saving this definition.

category.description: intrip is rejected because a real itinerary/revision binding is not supplied.

threshold.description: Finite user-configured value with explicit metric and unit; no provider coverage, conversion or rule evaluation is inferred.

timezone.description: Timezone accepted by the server's Intl.DateTimeFormat; retained as trimmed user input.

channel.description: Configured preference only; no permission, device token, entitlement or delivery path is established.

expiresAt.description: Explicit expiry or null; saving an expired value is not rejected or evaluated by this configuration path.

NotificationRuleCommand.description: update-rule replaces the full definition; set-rule-enabled changes only the saved enabled flag. Both require the current baseRevision.

NotificationRuleResult.description: The receipt and rule describe the original committed effect. replayed true does not promise that revision is still current.

observedAt.description: User-confirmed UTC or explicitly offset instant; normalized to UTC. Not an attested device capture.

place.description: User-confirmed label and optional selected identity. No coordinates, visit verification or coordinate grant is inferred.
